rawContent: What's on Thu, Feb 7? Our first @clearlinesuk event of 2019! A new collaboration with @MediaLSE @LSEGenderTweet @onroadmedia about representations of gender-based violence in the media. Check out more details for this FREE public event! #endVAWG #MeToo  https://t.co/XUSDFSa9Ve

Went to a great @Angles_project workshop this wk with @IpsoNews on their latest guidelines for sexual assault survivors who are contacted by the media. So many ethics that need to be considered. Thanks for all your important work on this! #MeToo #mediastudies #endVAWG #MeToomvnt https://t.co/Zk7txOgZdS

What are some of the problematic ways the media portrays domestic violence? Join us Feb 7th for our next @clearlinesuk event at @MediaLSE @LSEGenderTweet @onroadmedia - we'll be discussing with @PenelopeEA @misszing & @natmc Don't miss it! #endVAWG #MeToo  https://t.co/XUSDFSa9Ve
Woah #AlexSalmond news 😲😲😲 #MeToo #endVAWG

And tomorrow (Thu, Feb 7) is our first @clearlinesuk event of 2019! Kicking off our new collaboration with @MediaLSE @LSEGenderTweet & @onroadmedia on Gender, Media & the Survivor. Free to attend - details below! #endVAWG #MeToo #DV

This morning I was at @SkyUK HQ where I had a fantastic chat with @skynewsniall about #DarkChapter & how to change the conversation about sexual consent & #rapeculture Stay tuned to see our talk on #Divided online @SkyNews in the next few months! #endVAWG #MeToo #ItsNotOk https://t.co/8Bg6rCv3Fm

I turned down a request to appear on @SkyNews tonight - partly because I myself am still parsing out my thoughts on #MJ  
#FindingNeverland & separating the art from the artist (which I’m not in favor of, but oh man... with #MichaelJackson - that’s a tough one for me) #MeToo

Happy #IWD2019 ! Started this morning in a great group discussion at @southbankcentre with the eminent @Purna_UNW @HelenaKennedyQC & this fantastic group of activists on workplace #sexualharassment & changing the culture to #endVAWG @WOWtweetUK #InternationalWomansDay #MeToo https://t.co/KMNzik6hzq

‘There is an attempt to roll back the advances that have been made. We have a duty to keep speaking up’ @thatginamiller at this brilliant event on gender equality with @HelenaKennedyQC @RachelReevesMP I’ve a front row seat! #IWD2019 #MeToo @britishlibrary @RSLiterature #RSLTalks https://t.co/6J7Vqi8QXF

10 yrs ago today, I flew to Belfast for the trial against my rapist. The most unbearable period of my life. I'm one of the 'lucky' few victims who saw a conviction, but the process of seeking justice can be so destructive for victims. The system needs to change. #IWD2019 #MeToo

Here at @BBCNews Broadcasting House recording a fantastic talk with @KimChakanetsa & fellow survivor-activist Brisa de Angulo @ABreezeofHope (Bolivia/US) on sexual assault & changing the culture. Coming soon on #TheConversation @bbcworldservice ! #MeToo #StrongerTogether https://t.co/kCzsnb7nNU

And on Thursday I'm headed up north to Preston to speak at this free event for @UCLanEandD on #sexualassault #changingtheculture #MeToo #InclusiveUCLan #diversity Will be great to speak alongside @Emilytest12  again! https://t.co/SYHlo4gwzm

... and #Ireland has in many ways served as the scene of my rape, regrowth, and recovery. Thank you for all the support! #StPatricksDay #MeToo #endVAWG @SAFEIreland @RapeCrisisNI @ConsentUCD Here's an @IrishTimes  @SusanMcKay15 feature about me in 2015 https://t.co/lkjm5aNn2y

Ahh here’s us @Emilytest12 & myself about to speak at @UCLanEandD Fiona Drouet’s talk is always so moving & honest on revealing the impact of #VAWG on all our lives - an honour to be invited to speak here in Preston #inclusiveuclan #endVAWG #MeToo https://t.co/ixW34EMpSj

Spotted in the current issue of @RadioTimes ! Tune into @SkyNews today at 11:10. I’ll be on air commenting on this story: is it really necessary for rape victims to give up their phones in order for justice to go forward? #MeToo #endvawg @clearlinesuk

And I’ve just left @channel5_tv studios, where I spoke with @catherine5news about my rape in 2008 & what it would have been like to give up my phone (my only link to the outside world) at a very vulnerable time in my life. Tune in at 6:30! #DarkChapter @clearlinesuk #MeToo https://t.co/5J1QgDEnnw

This is now fully booked out! ... people are starting to take rape survivors & #MeToo allegations seriously. My point: DON’T UNDERESTIMATE RAPE SURVIVORS. Yes, there is pain & an ‘emotional toll’ when we speak out, but we do it from a place of truth & conviction. And because we want things to change for...

... I won’t run into the same problem again! Some of the strongest, most resilient people I know are rape & sexual assault survivors. DON’T UNDERESTIMATE US. #MeToo #StrongerTogether #endVAWG #BreakTheSilence #DarkChapter #BrightChapter
